mechanism: Fine-tuning of code language models on program repair training data
evidence_scope: it is the first work to fine-tune CLMs with APR training data, which shows that fine- tuning brings 31%–1,267% improvement to CLMs
evidence_role: this work is the first to evaluate ten CLMs on four APR benchmarks, which shows that surprisingly, the best CLM, as is, fixes 72% more bugs than the state-of-the-art deep-learning (DL)-based APR techniques.
